column1: # Commands whose behaviour differs between GNU (Linux) and BSD (macOS) userlands,
# and words that mark platform-specific code. A pull request whose ADDED lines in
# a tracked .sh/.bash/.bats/.mjs file match one of these needs the macOS legs of
# the suite (mac-needed.mjs). One row per pattern: <name><TAB><JavaScript regex>.
# tests/test_ci_mac_needed.bats runs every row against a line that must match and
# a line that must not, so a row cannot rot into matching nothing or everything.
